title: Keep annotations clear of wires and pin text
summary: Keep references, values and labels readable and clear of neighboring wires or annotations.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
limitations: An electrical check does not establish visual readability.

title: Check text at the intended reading scale
summary: Use consistent text sizing and inspect exported output. KLC normally uses 50 mil fields, with smaller pin-text exceptions.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
verification: Check the smallest pin text at intended print or display size.
limitations: KLC values are library conventions, not a universal typography standard.

title: Keep power and ground presentation consistent
summary: Prefer positive supply pins above and ground or negative pins below; power-conversion symbols can use input-left/output-right.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
verification: Check that graphical orientation matches the documented domain.
limitations: Ground symbol appearance does not establish isolation or justify merging grounds.

title: Account for every unit and its power connections
summary: When a library separates shared power into a unit, make that unit and its association easy to find.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; retain cited tool or library scope.
verification: Check reference identity and power pins.
limitations: KLC separates shared power for multi-unit symbols; it does not recommend removing power from single-unit symbols.

title: Keep local feedback and support circuits understandable
summary: Editorial convention: show local feedback, bias and timing components beside the circuitry they explain; associate decoupling groups with their IC and rail.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; editorial convention informed by the cited background.
verification: Trace the local loop without unrelated sheet jumps.
limitations: Editorial convention, not a source-mandated rule. Drawing proximity does not specify physical PCB placement; do not replace every local connection with a label just to reduce wire count.

title: State connector orientation when pin interpretation matters
summary: Editorial convention: state the mating or board view and identify connector signals without changing pin numbering.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; editorial convention informed by the cited background.
verification: Cross-check the stated view against its datasheet.
limitations: Editorial convention, not a source-mandated rule. Schematic symbol position is not a physical connector view.

citations.locator: Orientation of Through Hole Components; background for orientation clarity

title: Show essential values, configuration and design intent
summary: Editorial convention: keep essential values visible, identify sheet purpose and revision, and place concise notes on configuration, DNP options and important assumptions near the affected circuit.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; editorial convention informed by the cited background.
verification: Check notes and values against released data.
limitations: Editorial convention, not a source-mandated rule. Do not substitute prose for electrical connections or formal assembly data.

citations.locator: Incomplete design notes and incorrect values

title: Review the final exported schematic independently
summary: Editorial convention: inspect every exported page for clipped content, missing fields and unreadable annotations; retain meaning without color alone.
applies_to: Schematic visual review; editorial convention informed by the cited background.
verification: Review at intended size and compare connectivity before and after cleanup.
limitations: Editorial convention, not a source-mandated rule. A render review complements ERC; neither proves circuit operation.
